status_code_data.description: The HTTP 500 Internal Server Error server error response status code indicates that the server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request. This error is a generic "catch-all" response to server issues, indicating that the server cannot find a more appropriate 5XX error to respond with.

meme_data.description: Praying to the server gods is an image depicting technicians kneeling and praying to server hardware as if performing a ritual. It is used to humorously express desperation or superstition when dealing with broken code or server outages
